content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Targeted image changes can alter details you need to preserve. This skill guides Flux Kontext Pro edits through RunComfy using focused prompts and explicit preservation instructions.
actual_capabilities: Guide single-image edits through the RunComfy Flux 1 Kontext Pro endpoint.
Structure prompts that specify a targeted change and details to preserve.
Provide CLI examples with image URLs, optional seeds, and an output directory.
Explain supported aspect-ratio selection and sequential editing for complex requests.
Recommend alternative models for multiple references, multilingual text, or generation without a source.
Document login options and CLI exit codes for troubleshooting.
limitations: Requires the separate RunComfy CLI, an account, and network access; images are processed remotely.
Accepts one source image through a publicly fetchable HTTPS URL, not multiple references.
Complex prompts may cause unwanted changes; preservation and text accuracy are not guaranteed.
Only documentation is bundled; CLI security claims and service behavior are not independently verified.

use_cases.title: Refine a Portrait
use_cases.description: Add an accessory while explicitly requesting preservation of the subject's face, pose, and clothing.

use_cases.title: Explore Packaging Variants
use_cases.description: Request a label text or color change while keeping the bottle shape, background, and lighting consistent.

use_cases.title: Compare Prompt Variants
use_cases.description: Use the documented CLI workflow and a fixed seed to compare focused edits to one approved source image.

prompt_templates.title: Make One Simple Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro to add an orange umbrella to the person in [image URL]. Preserve the face, pose, and clothing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one focused change to a source image.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Product Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [image URL] with Flux Kontext Pro. Keep the bottle silhouette, table, and lighting unchanged. Replace label text ALPHA with AURA.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Seeded Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: For [image URL], compare two focused shoulder-bag edits using seed 42. Preserve the person and scene. Save each result separately in [output directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare prompt variations with a shared seed.

prompt_templates.title: Split a Complex Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan two sequential Flux Kontext edits for [image URL]: change the background, then the clothing. Preserve identity throughout. Confirm each result before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review each stage of a sequential editing workflow.

output_examples.input: Draft a Flux Kontext prompt to add an umbrella while preserving the portrait.
output_examples.output: Keep the person's face, pose, and clothing unchanged. Add an orange umbrella in the left hand.

output_examples.input: Prepare a packaging label edit from ALPHA to AURA.
output_examples.output: Keep the bottle silhouette, table, and lighting unchanged. Replace only ALPHA with AURA. Preserve the font weight, white lettering, and centered placement.

output_examples.input: I need edits using several reference images.
output_examples.output: Flux Kontext Pro uses one source image in this workflow. Consider Nano Banana Edit for multiple references.

best_practices: State what must remain unchanged before describing one focused edit.
Use only images approved for third-party processing and confirm the output directory before running the CLI.
Reuse a seed for comparisons and inspect each result before starting another edit.
anti_patterns: Combining many unrelated changes in one prompt.
Passing several references or requesting generation without a source image.
Publishing confidential images to satisfy the public URL requirement without authorization.

faq.question: What must I install?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI separately and authenticate with a RunComfy account. The skill provides instructions, not the CLI implementation.

faq.question: Does the model run locally?
faq.answer: No. The CLI runs locally, but RunComfy processes the image remotely and returns generated outputs.

faq.question: Can I use multiple source images?
faq.answer: This workflow accepts one source image. The skill recommends Nano Banana Edit for multiple references.

faq.question: How do I preserve important details?
faq.answer: Name the details to preserve before specifying one change. Inspect the result because preservation is not guaranteed.

faq.question: Can I compare variants with a fixed seed?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented seed field supports variant comparisons. Reuse the same source and seed when comparing prompt changes.

faq.question: How is authentication handled?
faq.answer: The documentation describes browser login with local token storage or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for automation. Storage permissions and runtime behavior were not independently verified.
